## Summary

Describe the smallest useful change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Code or test
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Research claim or source
- [ ] Tooling or dependency maintenance

## Evidence class

- [ ] Riot statement
- [ ] Microsoft platform mechanism
- [ ] Project inference
- [ ] Demonstrator result
- [ ] Not applicable

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally.
- [ ] Claims and sources are updated where required.
- [ ] No personal data, private document, generated Office/PDF/ZIP file, or copyrighted source copy is committed.
- [ ] The change stays within the ethical boundary.
- [ ] Limitations and uncertainty are stated.

## Screenshots or output

Add only when they materially help review. Remove personal or sensitive data.
